name: Kimberly Cobos Cawthorne
office: City of Montebello, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Kimberly Cobos Cawthorne previously represented District 1 on the Montebello City Council. She served as mayor from 2020 to 2022. In her 2022 campaign, she said she helped establish the Montebello Community Assistance Program to connect homeless residents with medical and mental health care. She also said she secured funding for the "Paving the Way" street repair project. In 2019, she supported limiting the number of cannabis businesses in the city to avoid over-saturation.

items.text: In 2020 as mayor, she noted the installation of two solar-powered EV charging terminals. She also supported the opening of a tiny home village. In 2022, she voted to move to district-based elections, saying it would save the city money.
